says: On main, the law that preferSchemaTaggedError stays at error in every tracked tsconfig fails: 12 project tsconfigs set their own @effect/language-service plugin entry with a diagnosticSeverity that leaves the check out, so the law reads it as undefined.
proof: On a clean checkout of main at b490a3203, `volta run --node 26.13.0 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 oxlint-plugins/effect-checks-held.test.ts` fails with 12 lines such as `.agents/tsconfig.json: preferSchemaTaggedError is undefined` and `next/programs/counter/tsconfig.json: preferSchemaTaggedError is undefined`. next/programs/counter/tsconfig.json sets `diagnosticSeverity: { preferBarrelImport: "error" }` only.
cost: Either the law is wrong about how a project's plugin entry merges with the base, or those 12 projects really run the checker without the check at error. Until one is settled, a branch whose proof run reaches this file goes red for a reason it did not cause.
